title: Interoperability Effects: Extending DeFi Lending Risk Models to Multi-Chain Environments
abstract: arXiv:2605.12508v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-chain lending has expanded across multiple distributed ledgers as DeFi becomes increasingly multi-chain. This environment introduces novel technical and financial mechanisms, particularly cross-blockchain communication and asset transfer protocols, yet cross-chain elements remain understudied in lending protocol risk management. To address this gap, we applied panel regression fixed effects and OLS models to empirically analyze the impact of cross-blockchain interoperability solutions, using TVL and total revenue as performance proxies from October 2022 to January 2025. Our data set covers 15 decentralized lending protocols and 53 cross-chain bridges across 9 EVM-compatible blockchains, categorized as Ethereum, alternative layer-1s, and Ethereum layer-2 networks. translated_title: 互操作性效应：将DeFi借贷风险模型扩展至多链环境
translated_abstract: 随着DeFi日益多链化，链上借贷已扩展到多个分布式账本。这种环境引入了新颖的技术和金融机制，特别是跨区块链通信和资产转移协议，然而跨链元素在借贷协议风险管理中仍研究不足。为弥补这一空白，我们应用面板回归固定效应和OLS模型，以TVL和总收入作为绩效代理变量，实证分析了跨区块链互操作解决方案的影响，时间跨度从2022年10月至2025年1月。我们的数据集涵盖9个兼容EVM的区块链上的15个去中心化借贷协议和53个跨链桥，并将其分类为以太坊、替代性第一层网络和以太坊第二层网络。结果显示，跨链活动对协议绩效有显著影响。桥接量成为一个重要的解释变量，表现出显著的相关性。
tldr: 本文通过实证分析发现，跨链桥接量是影响多链环境中DeFi借贷协议绩效的关键因素，扩展了传统借贷风险模型以纳入互操作性效应。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically shows that cross-chain bridge volume is a key factor affecting DeFi lending protocol performance in multi-chain environments, extending traditional lending risk models to incorporate interoperability effects.
